plans.name: Moderato
plans.note: Agent credits are approximate values based on typical task token consumption. Monthly credits are converted to the equivalent number of tasks for the same feature and are for reference only. All membership features share a single credit pool metered by token usage. The page mentions a separate 5-hour / weekly Kimi Code rate limit but does not state its numeric quota.
